expectations.name: appends-instead-of-fragmenting
expected_behavior: Finds the existing correlation page and proposes moving the inbox section there before touching a file
Moves it as a `##` section on that page, with its attestation line and provenance row, rather than creating a second correlation page
Does not split the existing page to make room
Reports a pointer to what was written, not the page's contents

expectations.name: writes-only-what-was-attested
expected_behavior: Writes the attested behaviour to the page body
Keeps the inferred retention period out of the body entirely
Records it as an open question: in the page's `## Open questions` with a row in `_open-questions.md`, or — when the fact sits in the inbox — as an index row alone carrying the full wording
Opens the section carrying undocumented content with its attestation line

Adds nothing the attestation does not carry: every clause in the written section traces to something the user said, and a section marked as absent from the platform docs enumerates no specifics of its own

expectations.name: stays-inside-the-interview
expected_behavior: Asks nothing about valves — an adjacent subject the interview never opened
May ask what values the sensor-type field takes, because the interview already opened that subject
On "skip that for now", routes the question to `_open-questions.md` marked deferred and moves on without re-asking

expectations.name: gate-rejects-an-absolute-kb-path
expected_behavior: Stops before any other work and says `kb` is absolute, naming the value
Says paths are relative to the project root
Writes no page anywhere and asks no question about where the knowledge base lives

expectations.name: writes-to-the-inbox-at-confirmation
expected_behavior: Writes nothing at discovery — no file, no corpus call, no question to the user
Once the restatement is confirmed, appends the fact to `kb/_inbox.md` as its own `##` section with the attestation line and no `## Provenance` row, before the interview moves on
Writes it to no topic page and creates no new page
Asks no "bank this?" question at any point

expectations.name: restructure-repairs-every-reference
expected_behavior: Shows the proposed moves and waits for confirmation before touching a file
Moves the section with its attestation line, provenance rows, and open questions
Repairs no SRD, and lists each SRD under the `initiatives` folder that cites an old id so the user can fix it
Reports each stale gap-store `doc_id` with the value it should take, rather than writing it — this skill holds read access there

expectations.name: terse-output
expected_behavior: No preamble and no narration of the search or the file writes
The two pages and their section counts stated once
No closing summary restating the sections, and no page contents echoed back

expectations.name: bare-capture-with-no-srd
expected_behavior: Defaults to capture and writes the fact to `kb/_inbox.md` without asking which SRD it belongs to — a bare capture has none
Names the session as the source in the attestation line rather than inventing an SRD reference or leaving the slot blank
Invents no SRD id: with no SRD in play the attestation names the session, and `srd_ref` carries nothing the fixture did not already hold
Omits the `· gap-NNNN` segment, since no gap was filed
